land.text: Turra and the Jebel Marra, Daali's base

predecessors.note: The last Tunjur king, Shaw Dorshid, 'around the mid-16th century'; his half-brother Daali usurped the kingship. No dossier exists yet for the Tunjur.

land.text: Darfur, 'incorporated into the Anglo-Egyptian Condominium in 1917'

successors.note: The infobox 'Succeeded by' lists Turco-Egyptian Sudan and Anglo-Egyptian Sudan; the Turco-Egyptian interval (1874-1898) is recorded as a loss to khedivate-of-egypt and a gain from mahdist-state.

capitals.name: Turra (Jebel Marra)
capitals.note: Infobox capitals 'Turra; Kobbe (before 1790); al-Fashir (after 1790)'; Shoba was Tayrab's first main fashir. The moves between Turra, Kobbe and Shoba are undated and the page gives no coordinates, so the point is the Jebel Marra massif as a proxy.

capitals.name: El Fasher
capitals.note: The text has Abd al-Rahman founding al-Fashir in 1792 (the infobox says after 1790).

capitals.name: El Fasher
capitals.note: Ali Dinar restored self-rule in 1898; the Ali Dinar page does not call El Fasher a capital but names it as the town where he surrendered in 1891 and the Darfur page keeps it as the capital 'after 1790'.

correction.text: Turra and the Jebel Marra, Daali's base

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe 1550-1608: the infobox gives 'Established: mid-16th century (Daali)', Cliopatria starts in 1609. The first state is the Keira base at Turra in the Jebel Marra (Central Darfur); the page does not say how far Daali's 'five provinces' reached, so the Cliopatria outline enters at 1609 by a confidence-1 bridge. Sulayman Solong is dated 1596-1637 (Nachtigal) or c. 1660-c. 1680 (O'Fahey) and the page does not settle it.

296k km2 for 1609-1611 (Darfur proper, 22.1-27.8 E, 10.8-16.6 N). Neither the Darfur nor the Ali Dinar infobox gives an area, so no comparison; 'At its peak in the late-18th and early-19th century it stretched all the way' to the White Nile, which only the Kordofan years add.
297k km2 for 1612-1635, the same outline; nothing on the page changes in 1612.

correction.text: The Cliopatria 1636 shape unchanged, applied for 1636-1784

keyframe_review.note: 294k km2 for 1636-1821, with no Kordofan beyond its western edge (61 cells of the Kordofan region lie inside). Holds 1636-1784; from c. 1785 the Fur hold Kordofan ('Around 1785 Tayrab invaded') until the Egyptian conquest of 1821; see sultanate-of-darfur_1785.

minus.text: the Nuba Mountains, the Kingdom of Taqali's (not Darfur's) from c. 1750

correction.text: Darfur proper plus Kordofan without the Nuba Mountains, for 1785-1821

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe 1785-1821: Kordofan added. Infobox 'Conquest of Kordofan: c. 1785': 'Around 1785 Tayrab invaded, and Darfur's forces reached the Nile near Shendi.' It ends when 'the Turco-Egyptians under Muhammad Ali conquered the Funj and Kordofan' and a Keira army was routed near Bara on 19 August 1821. Fix fx-16 (2026-11-01): South Kordofan (the Nuba Mountains, 533 cells) is left out, because the Kingdom of Taqali dossier holds it from c. 1750. Kingdom of Taqali page: the state 'was centered on the Taqali Massif and spread to encompassed all of the Nuba Mountains' (infobox 1750), 'the highest part of the Nuba Hills in the Kordofan region', and it makes no mention of Darfur or the Keira; this page says only that Kordofan 'had no natural boundaries save for the Nuba mountains' and mentions neither Taqali nor South Kordofan, nor any Fur campaign into the hills. The Nuba Mountains are read as the edge of Fur Kordofan.

294k km2 for 1822-1872, Darfur proper again after the Egyptian conquest of Kordofan. Nothing else on the page moves the border; Zubayr Rahma began operations south of Darfur in 1856 without taking land.

correction.text: The Cliopatria 1873 shape unchanged, applied for 1873-1874

keyframe_review.note: 294k km2 for 1873-1876. The sultanate falls in 1874: Ibrahim was killed at the Battle of al-Manawashi in autumn 1874, Hassab Alla was captured in 1875 and Darfur was administered as a province. Holds 1873-1874; the land is then Egyptian, then Mahdist (the Darfur page has the Mahdists conquering Darfur in 1885; the mahdist-state dossier dates it 1883).

correction.text: The Darfur outline of 1873, restored for 1898-1916

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe 1898-1916 (Cliopatria has no shape): Ali Dinar's restored sultanate. Infobox 'Reign: September 1898 - 6 November 1916'; the Darfur infobox 'Independence from the Mahdist State: 1898'. The 1873 outline is reused; the pages give no extent for the restored state, and the Wadai War page says the 'Wadai-Darfur borders stayed disputed'.

region.text: Turra and the Jebel Marra, Daali's base

ledger.note: Mid-16th century: Daali founds the Keira state at Turra. Infobox 'Established: mid-16th century (Daali)'; Daali, half-brother of the last Tunjur king Shaw Dorshid (who ruled around the mid-16th century), usurped the kingship. 1550 is a rounding of the page's span.

minus.text: Turra and the Jebel Marra, Daali's base

region.text: the rest of Darfur proper beyond the Jebel Marra

ledger.note: 1609: the Cliopatria outline of Darfur proper begins. Daali is credited with 'the five provinces' and Sulayman Solong is the 'second founder', but the page dates neither and puts Sulayman at 1596-1637 or c. 1660-1680; 1609 is Cliopatria's first year (page silent).

17th century: Wadai is a tributary of Darfur. The Wadai page: Wadai was a tributary of Darfur through the 17th century; the page gives no start, so 1636 is Cliopatria's first Wadai year (page silent on the start).

End of the 17th century: Wadai stops paying tribute. Wadai was a tributary of Darfur through the 17th century; Ya'qub Arus later refused tribute and, the page says, 'Darfur attacked Wadai but was defeated'. The refusal is undated; 1700 closes the century.

minus.text: the Nuba Mountains, the Kingdom of Taqali's (not Darfur's) from c. 1750

ledger.note: c. 1785: Tayrab takes Kordofan. Infobox 'Conquest of Kordofan: c. 1785'; the page has Tayrab invading Kordofan around 1785, after the Musabba'at and the Funj had contested it. The funj-sultanate dossier records the same loss and quotes the page on the Funj withdrawal. Fix fx-16: the Nuba Mountains are left out (Kingdom of Taqali page: Taqali held them as its own kingdom; this page does not mention them).
1792: Abd al-Rahman founds al-Fashir and moves the capital there. The text says 'in 1792'; the infobox has Turra and Kobbe 'before 1790' and al-Fashir 'after 1790'.

minus.text: the Nuba Mountains, the Kingdom of Taqali's (not Darfur's) from c. 1750

ledger.note: 19 August 1821: the Egyptians take Kordofan. The page: in 1821 the Turco-Egyptians under Muhammad Ali conquered the Funj and Kordofan, and a Keira army was routed near Bara on 19 August 1821. Fix fx-16: the Nuba Mountains are left out, as in /ledger/4; the Egyptians' dealings with Taqali are in the Taqali dossier.

1838: Darfur installs Sharif in Wadai. The Wadai page: Darfur installed Sharif in 1838 after a disputed succession, and he quickly regained independence. Muhammad al-Fadl of Darfur died in 1838 (Darfur page).
Sharif quickly regained independence; the page gives no year, so 1839 is a bridge.

Autumn 1874: Darfur falls. The page has Ibrahim killed at the Battle of al-Manawashi in autumn 1874 (infobox: conquered by al-Zubayr Rahma Mansur, 1874); Hassab Alla was captured in 1875 and taken to Cairo, and Darfur was then administered as a province (infobox: succeeded by Turco-Egyptian Sudan). Cliopatria keeps the shape to 1876.

September 1898: Ali Dinar restores the sultanate. Ali Dinar page infobox 'Reign: September 1898 - 6 November 1916'; Darfur page: Ali Dinar restored self-rule in 1898, infobox 'Independence from the Mahdist State: 1898' (the Mahdists had conquered Darfur in 1885, the mahdist-state dossier says 1883).

1916: the British invade Darfur. 'In 1915 Ali Dinar declared his support to the Ottoman Empire in the First World War'; the British government then sent an invasion of Darfur in 1916 (the page gives no month).
6 November 1916: Ali Dinar is killed. 'Died: 6 November 1916 ... Jabal Juba, Darfur.'

region.text: Darfur, annexed to the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan

ledger.note: 6 November 1916: the Sultanate of Darfur ends. The page: the British conquered Darfur in 1916 and Dinar was killed in battle; Darfur was incorporated into the Anglo-Egyptian Condominium in 1917.

wars.name: Darfur-Wadai conflicts
wars.outcome: Umar Lel invaded Wadai and was captured c. 1739; Bukr repelled Sultan Ya'qub with Egyptian weapons; Tayrab later judged Wadai too formidable. The Wadai page adds that Wadai paid tribute through the 17th century and that Darfur installed Sharif in 1838. No border moved.
wars.note: The tribute and the 1838 installation are ledger vassal events.

wars.name: Darfur conquest of Kordofan
wars.outcome: Tayrab invades about 1785 as the Funj withdraw amid civil war; Darfur's forces reach the Nile near Shendi; Kordofan becomes Fur land.

wars.name: Turco-Egyptian conquest of Kordofan
wars.outcome: The Egyptians take the Funj lands and Kordofan; a Keira army is routed near Bara on 19 August 1821 and Darfur loses Kordofan.

wars.name: Zubayr Rahma Mansur's conquest of Darfur
wars.outcome: Zubayr begins operations south of Darfur in 1856; Sultan Ibrahim is killed at al-Manawashi in autumn 1874 and Hassab Alla is captured in 1875; Darfur becomes an Egyptian province.
wars.note: The page does not name Zubayr Pasha as an Egyptian official; the Egyptian side is the infobox 'Succeeded by: Turco-Egyptian Sudan'.

wars.name: British conquest of Darfur
wars.outcome: The British invade after Ali Dinar's 1915 declaration for the Ottomans; he is killed on 6 November 1916 and Darfur joins the Anglo-Egyptian Sudan in 1917.
wars.note: The Ali Dinar page gives no month for the invasion.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey fixes any Darfur frontier; the Wadai-Darfur border 'stayed disputed' after the 1898-1899 Anglo-French division, and the Kordofan edge is approximate.

notes:
Pages opened: three (budget 5); the Wadai War page (read for wadai-empire) adds the 1898-1899 Anglo-French division. No infobox on the Darfur or Ali Dinar pages gives an area, so none was compared. The origin is dated only 'mid-16th century' (1550 is a rounding) and the Cliopatria outline of 296k km2 enters at 1609 by a confidence-1 bridge; Sulayman Solong's dates (1596-1637 or c. 1660-1680) are not settled by the page. Cliopatria stops in 1876 and has nothing for 1898-1916; the dossier ends the sultanate on 6 November 1916 and treats 1875-1897 as lost land (Egypt, then the Mahdists), recorded as a loss in 1874 and a regain in September 1898. The Darfur page dates the Mahdist conquest 1885, the mahdist-state dossier 1883; and the Ali Dinar page contradicts itself (ascended 1891 in the lead, reign from September 1898 in the infobox). No rulers strip: the list on the Darfur page has no reign years for most sultans. Not mapped: the extent of the restored state and the Darfur-Wadai frontier. Counterparts needing dossiers: tunjur-kingdom. Gazetteer lacks Jebel Marra, Turra, Bara, al-Manawashi.
Fix fx-16 (2026-11-01): the Kordofan of 1785-1821 no longer includes South Kordofan (the Nuba Mountains): the Kingdom of Taqali dossier holds it from c. 1750 and the Darfur page never places the Fur there. The keyframe claimed those 533 cells in 1785 against Taqali.
